**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Integrate the arithmetic oracle into the Hspec suite**

When developers or validation lanes run the documented `stack test` command, this standalone `Main` module is skipped because it is only invoked by the bespoke command in `ci.yml`; consequently, its 400 transition and 512 ledger boundary checks can silently stop running outside that workflow. Convert the probe to an Hspec `*.Spec.hs` module and register it with the existing test suite so the standard backend test command includes this regression coverage.
